title: docs(skills): type-check more objectstack-formula examples with os:check
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb9N2bXVZjKY6oCBfL3iTddq)_

Refs #31112 (slice 4 of a per-skill split: item 4, objectstack-formula; the card stays open)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:objectstack-formula 技能包的 SKILL.md 又有 5 段 TypeScript 示例接入了示例编译检查(9 段中由 1 段变为 6 段),涉及文本公式、除数保护、动态种子值和两段 `previous` 状态转换条件;没有发现写错的示例。
- 为什么改:AI 编写公式、条件和种子值时最先照抄这些示例;接入检查后,规范一旦改名或收紧,示例会在 CI 里立刻变红,而不是悄悄教错。
- 风险与回滚:只改发布技能包的文档文字,不动任何运行时代码;token 上限未抬高(5956 → 5973 / 5997),新增字节靠同文件删减三处重复说明支付(每处删减的规则都在同文件另有出处)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` 的「Mandatory patterns for AI emission」一节(5 处新标记与新增的 import 行)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples`,预期最后一行为 337 段示例全部通过类型检查。
- 需要你做的:作为受管面审批人审阅并批准本 PR(skills/** 属 Tier H)。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-formula` had 1 of its 9 fenced `ts` blocks under `check:skill-examples` (measured on `main` 4013e308; every block sits in `SKILL.md`; `references/_index.md` is generator-owned and holds none; `evals/` excluded). It now has 6. Each new mark is the os:check marker on the line above the fence plus one import line; the seed block also gains `const seed = ` and `;` on its existing line.

| File | marked before → after / blocks | tokens before → after / ceiling | lines before → after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `SKILL.md` | 1 → 6 / 9 | 5956 → 5973 / 5997 | 487 → 494 |

Skills bundle reading: the sum of every published `SKILL.md` moves by +7 lines (this file only).

- §1 coalesced text formula and §2 guarded divisor: `import { F } from '@objectstack/spec';`.
- §4 dynamic seed values: `import { cel } from '@objectstack/spec';` and `const seed = { … };` (a bare `{ a: x, b: y }` statement is a block with labels and does not parse).
- §5 `previous`/`record` transition and the bulk-write transition predicate: `import { P } from '@objectstack/spec';`.
- Unmarked: the three ❌ blocks (string concatenation on nullable operands, Salesforce-flavor strings, `new Date()` seeds). They are wrong on purpose, and the file now says so once, under the section heading.

## Why

#31112 item 4 (ruling B of #22059): published examples are guarded by the opt-in type check. This slice brings objectstack-formula's self-contained examples under it.

### Example fixes

None. Every marked block compiled as written once its import was added.

### Trims that paid the marks (each cut and where its rule survives)

- Intro: "This skill is the canonical reference for AI authors emitting formula / condition / predicate / dynamic-seed metadata." cut; the frontmatter `description` says what the skill covers and who loads it.
- §5: "ISCHANGED-style logic does not exist as a function; use explicit `previous` comparison." cut; survives in the Mechanical translation table row `ISCHANGED(x)` → `previous.x != record.x` and in §5's own "Comparing against `previous` is the only way to say 'just became'".
- §3: "For field-level conditional rules, emit the canonical field properties: `visibleWhen`, `readonlyWhen`, and `requiredWhen`." folded into "Never emit `conditionalRequired` (use `requiredWhen`) — …"; the three keys survive in the Surfaces table's `Field` row and the frontmatter `description`.

## Tests

<details><summary>check:skill-examples, before and after, and the reverse check</summary>

- Before (`main` 4013e308): `✅ 332 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)`.
- After (commit b484a209; head b372dba1 adds only a merge of `main` touching no `skills/**` or `packages/spec` path): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` exited 0 with `✅ 337 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s) — every marked block parsed, so tsc ran the SEMANTIC pass on all of them`.
- Reverse check, after the commit: planted a wrong import (`import { F, Field }`, `SKILL.md:240`) and an unknown member on the seed's `cel` envelope (`.bogusKey`, `SKILL.md:296`). The checker exited 1 with TS2305 and TS2339 at exactly those lines. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`; `git status --porcelain` was empty after.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate sweep (commit b484a209)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 46 commands. 45 exited 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: needs every package's dist; CI runs it). `dispatch-gates --ran` exited 0: 46 derived, 45 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 unrun. Re-run on the merged head b372dba1: `check-skills-token-ratchet`, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`, `check:skill-links`, `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`, all exit 0.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `check:skill-examples` is not in the derived gate list for a `skills/**` diff, so it was run by hand.
- No ceiling was raised or lowered; the ratchet printed no lowering instruction (headroom 24 left).
- This build ran on the default tier: `dispatch-gates --tier` mandates Fable for `skills/**`, and the claim records the no-Fable-build exit; the contract review is the seat's, on the lane's isolated reviewer.

## Verification

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` (needs `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/client-react` built) prints 337 examples green; `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` exits 0.

## Human Minimum

A governed approver reviews and approves (Tier H).
